pages.text: The Adventurer Neko is the most common neko type in the wild. Hardworking and capable, she's a $(#FF69B4)great farming helper$().

pages.title: Farming Expert
pages.text: The Adventurer Neko has a unique ability: $(#FF69B4)auto-harvesting and replanting crops$().$(br2)She actively seeks out mature crops nearby, harvests them, and takes seeds from her inventory to replant on farmland.$(br2)Harvested crops are also $(#FF69B4)deposited into nearby chests$() — just like a thoughtful little housekeeper!$(br2)This ability consumes her $(thing)Gathering Power$() — which is earned through gifts from players.

pages.title: Weapon Smith
pages.text: The Adventurer Neko is also a weapon smith! She can $(#FF69B4)auto-craft weapons$() from materials in her inventory:$(br2)$(li)First choice: $(item)Diamond Sword$()$(li)No diamonds? $(item)Iron Sword$()$(li)No iron? $(item)Stone Sword$()$(li)At minimum: $(item)Wooden Sword$()$(br2)Let her guard your home — she's absolutely reliable~

pages.title: Spawning & Likes
pages.text: Adventurer Nekos like to live in: mountains, forests, taiga, jungles, savannas, plains, rivers, and beaches.$(br2)They appear more frequently in $(#FF69B4)cherry groves$(), $(#FF69B4)flower forests$(), $(#FF69B4)sunflower plains$(), and $(#FF69B4)meadows$().$(br2)Her favorite gifts: $(item)Swords$(), all kinds of $(item)Armor$(), and $(item)Catnip$(). Gifting these will greatly boost her affection!
